causal_checks: After release, the ball moves downhill rather than uphill or sideways.
The ball starts with little or no motion and then gains speed along the incline.
The ball remains aligned with the ramp path while descending.
Gravity along the 20 degree incline causes increasing downhill displacement frame to frame.
The ramp and support blocks do not move when the ball is released.
The ball does not levitate above the ramp or pass through the ramp surface.
If the ball reaches the lower end, it exits or approaches the end in the downhill direction.

controlled_variables.initial_ball_state: at rest on the upper portion of the ramp
controlled_variables.scene_layout: ramp, support blocks, tabletop ruler markings, chalkboard/background remain fixed

expected_spec.expected_response: The red ball begins from rest and accelerates downhill along the ramp under gravity. Its motion follows the ramp direction, with speed increasing over time. The ball should remain in contact with or very near the ramp surface while rolling/sliding down the incline, then approach the lower end of the ramp. The ramp, supports, table, ruler markings, and background remain stationary.
failure_modes: ball moves uphill or sideways off the ramp without a physical cause
ball accelerates unrealistically fast or at constant speed from the first frame
ball floats, tunnels through the ramp, or loses contact in an implausible way
ramp angle changes during the rollout
ramp, supports, table, or background shift or deform
ball changes color, shape, size, or identity
camera cuts, pans, or changes viewpoint
an external actor or hidden mechanism pushes the ball
expected_spec.intervention: Release the red ball from rest on the ramp while the ramp is set to 20.0 degrees.
protected_anchors: red ball remains red, spherical, and visually distinct
ramp remains a straight light gray inclined plane/track
ramp angle remains shallow and consistent with 20 degrees
school lab/classroom context with tabletop, support blocks, ruler markings, and chalkboard/background
no new hands, tools, motors, or external pushes appear after release
expected_spec.target_system: A saturated red ball on a light gray instrumented inclined ramp in a school lab/classroom setting, viewed from a fixed three-quarter measurement camera.
